A task that allows an unbounded run cannot verify the success criterion of completing within 6 hours. A missing task or modification is required to enforce a timeout or measure runtime against the limit.

T029 describes 'setting node features... to zero' but lacks the explicit step to 're-evaluate the model on the test set to measure the R² drop' required by FR-008. The task description focuses only on feature removal, missing the critical evaluation step to verify the robustness check.
